title: 第23章 弟你是真苟哈第24章 九霄青云开榜主线
slug: 穿越庶长兄嫡弟竟是仙帝转世
content_zh:
两人未再乘銮驾，只是如同寻常修士般信步闲逛，山谷之中溪流潺潺，灵植吐纳，难得远离了族务繁杂。
这位少君难得有此等闲适兴致，云擎自然乐得奉陪，心神也不由得随着周遭宁静的景色放松了片刻。
就在云擎心神松懈的刹那，前方的云煌忽然动了。
他并未转身，毫无预兆地随意一抬手，对着虚空轻轻一握。
“嗡——！”
空间发出震鸣！刹那间，谷内光线骤暗，仿佛所有光芒都被那只手强行攫取！精纯浩瀚的煌阳神力如同百川归海，向着云煌的掌心疯狂汇聚！
一枚凝练到极致的光球，在他掌心之上旋转浮现。
那光球仿如一轮微缩的太阳，心核白炽，边缘流淌着熔金般的赤红流火，散发出让人神魂颤栗的恐怖能量。光球周围的空气剧烈扭曲，发出如同琉璃将碎的哀鸣。
纯粹由煌阳神力高度压缩凝聚而成的能量核！
一股极其不祥的预感流遍云擎全身…
不等他做出任何反应，云煌终于缓缓转过身，淡金眼瞳在掌中那轮微缩太阳的映照下，亮得惊心动魄，只见他唇角勾起一抹不怀好意的弧度：
“兄长既要演出‘虚弱’之态，本君怎忍心不相助呢。”
不给云擎拒绝的机会，他屈指轻轻一弹！
那枚散发着毁灭气息的能量核，并未攻向云擎，反而是化作一道金色流光，悄无声息地没入了云擎脚下的土地。
“轰————！！”
下一刹，以云擎为中心，方圆三丈内的地面骤然亮起无数道交织着烈焰与流光的金色阵纹！阵盘瞬间被激活，煌煌神光冲天而起，将云擎彻底吞没！
云擎只觉周身空间一白，仿佛被强行从原本的世界剥离，瞬间坠入了太阳的核心！无穷无尽的煌阳神力，从四面八方疯狂涌入他的体内！
并非攻击，而是一种……淬炼？！
不，让云擎说，更像是强行“灌注”！
炽热！灼痛！撕裂！

远比前日切磋时感受到的更加狂暴、更加原始的力量，如同亿万根烧红的钢针，狠狠扎入他的经脉、骨骼、脏腑，甚至深入灵魂！
混沌道胎自主疯狂运转，灰蒙的混沌之气汹涌而出，试图吞噬这些外来者。
然而，这股煌阳神力太过磅礴，太过纯粹，带着云煌那凌驾于万物之上的意志，强行与他的混沌之气碰撞、交融、湮灭！
“呃……！”
云擎闷哼一声，额角青筋瞬间暴起，玄色劲装下的肌肉因极致的痛苦而剧烈痉挛。他死死咬住牙关，齿缝间渗出血丝，重瞳之中混沌之气以前所未有的速度疯狂流转，试图解析、适应这毁灭性的力量。
他瞬间明白了云煌的意图。
云煌正用最霸道的方式，强行“帮助”他伪装伤势！
“抱元守一，引煌阳入混沌，以寂灭纳生机。”云煌清冷的声音穿透炽热的光焰，清晰地传入云擎几乎被灼痛淹没的识海。
云擎心神剧震，全力运功。混沌道胎，包容万物，衍化万法。
他将那狂暴的煌阳神力引入混沌气旋，以寂灭之意将其炽烈的“生”强行压制、剥离，再以混沌之道，将其破碎、分解，化作最本源的阳属性能量粒子，小心翼翼地融入自身的灵力循环。
时间在这一刻失去了意义。
不知过了多久，那充斥谷内的煌阳神光缓缓收敛，地面的阵纹逐渐黯淡下去。
云擎依旧站在原地，只是脸色苍白如纸，唇边挂着未干的血迹，气息紊乱虚弱，显得格外“真实”。
他目前看起来的确像是重伤未愈，连本源气息都变得混杂不稳。
content_en:
The two of them did not take the carriage again, but just strolled around like ordinary monks. The streams in the valley were gurgling and the spiritual plants were breathing in. It was rare to be far away from the complicated family affairs.
It was rare for this young gentleman to be in such a leisurely mood, so Yun Qing was naturally happy to accompany him, and his mind could not help but relax for a moment with the peaceful scenery around him.
Just when Yun Qing was relaxed, Yun Huang in front suddenly moved.
He did not turn around, but raised his hand casually without warning, and lightly shook the void.
“Buzz——!”
The space roared! In an instant, the light in the valley suddenly dimmed, as if all the light had been forcibly snatched away by that hand! The pure and vast divine power of Huangyang is like hundreds of rivers returning to the sea, gathering crazily towards Yunhuang's palm!
A ball of light that was condensed to the extreme spun and emerged in his palm.
The ball of light was like a miniature sun, with an incandescent core and red fire like molten gold flowing around its edge, exuding terrifying energy that made people tremble. The air around the light ball twisted violently, emitting a wail like glass about to break.
An energy core purely composed of the highly compressed and condensed power of Huangyang!
An extremely ominous premonition flowed throughout Yunqing's body...
Before he could make any reaction, Yunhuang finally turned around slowly. His pale golden eyes, illuminated by the miniature sun in his palm, were shockingly bright. The corners of his lips curled up with a malicious arc:
"Since my brother wants to show off his 'weakness', how can I bear not to help him?"
Without giving Yun Qing a chance to refuse, he flicked his finger!
The energy core exuding a destructive aura did not attack Yun Qing. Instead, it turned into a golden stream of light and quietly sank into the ground at Yun Qing's feet.
"Boom————!!"
The next moment, with Yun Qing as the center, the ground within a radius of three feet suddenly lit up with countless golden formations intertwined with flames and light! The array disk was activated instantly, and the brilliant divine light soared into the sky, completely engulfing Yun Qing!
Yun Qing felt that the space around him turned white, as if he had been forcibly separated from the original world and fell into the core of the sun in an instant! Endless divine power of the radiant sun poured into his body from all directions!
It's not an attack, but a kind of... tempering? !
No, let Yun Qing say, it's more like forced "infusion"!
Hot! Burning pain! Tear!
Far more violent and primitive power than what he felt during the sparring session the day before yesterday, like billions of red-hot steel needles, pierced into his meridians, bones, organs, and even penetrated into his soul!
The Chaos Dao Titus operates crazily on its own, and the gray energy of Chaos surges out, trying to devour these outsiders.
However, this brilliant divine power was too majestic and pure. With Yunhuang's will that overcame all things, it forcibly collided, blended, and annihilated with his chaotic energy!
"Uh...!"
Yun Qing groaned, the veins on his forehead suddenly popped out, and the muscles under the black suit spasmed violently due to the extreme pain. He gritted his teeth tightly, blood seeping between his teeth, and the energy of chaos flowed crazily in his eyes at an unprecedented speed, trying to analyze and adapt to this destructive power.
He instantly understood Yun Huang's intention.
Yunhuang was using the most domineering method to forcefully "help" him pretend to be injured!
"Hold Yuan Shouyi, lead the radiant sun into the chaos, and use silence to bring vitality." Yunhuang's cold voice penetrated the blazing flames and clearly passed into Yun Qing's sea of ​​​​consciousness, which was almost drowned by burning pain.
Yun Qing's mind was shaken and he tried his best to exercise. The embryo of chaos embraces all things and evolves all methods.
He introduced the violent divine power of the radiant sun into the chaotic cyclone, forcibly suppressed and peeled off its blazing "life" with the intention of annihilation, and then used the method of chaos to break and decompose it, turning it into the most original yang energy particles, and carefully integrating them into his own spiritual power cycle.
Time loses its meaning at this moment.
After an unknown amount of time, the brilliant divine light that filled the valley slowly converged, and the formation patterns on the ground gradually dimmed.
Yun Qing still stood where he was, but his face was as pale as paper, and there was a hint of uncertainty on his lips.The dried blood stains and the disordered and weak breath make it look particularly "real".
He does look like he has not recovered from a serious injury, and even his original aura has become mixed and unstable.
